title: The strong-side outlet closes
objective: Reassess an outlet when a forechecker occupies its side.
briefing: YOU control the puck beside Navy’s net on its centre-ice side. Gold 1 is near the direct lane to W. D2 is across the middle on the other side of the net. This drill permits a reverse if its route is available; it is not an automatic instruction. Navy defends the left net and attacks the right net.
cues: D2 is across the middle from YOU.
Gold 1 is near the direct route to W.

title: Step out of the forechecker’s shadow
objective: Create a visible receiving option for a defender.
briefing: Navy D1 has the puck. YOU are a wide support player near the blue line. Gold 1 is close to the direct passing route. Navy C is closer to the defended left net and nearer the middle. Reoffer support if a usable lane is available.
cues: Gold 1 is close to the direct route to YOU.
C is a navy inside support option.

title: Offer a deeper middle regroup option
objective: Provide a deeper middle option during a neutral-zone reset.
briefing: Navy D1 holds the puck just behind the defensive blue line. YOU are F2 in the neutral zone; F1 is farther up ice and wider. The coach asks YOU to offer an option closer to Navy’s net and nearer the middle, while checking the gold defenders.
cues: D1 has the puck behind the defensive blue line.
The coach asks F2 to offer deeper middle support.

title: The point shot has a blocker

cues: Gold 1 shares the centre lane between the puck and the attacking net.
